description: Per-server, per-agent rate limits for MCP tool calls through the APIM AI gateway. Single source of truth, keyed by MCP server 'name' (matching mcp/mcp.json); within a server, each agent is keyed by its Foundry agent 'name' only -- NO AppId GUIDs are committed here. AppIds do not exist until the agents are seeded (post-provision), so they are resolved at DEPLOY time: the deploy-compliancy workflow runs scripts/list-agent-appids.ps1 -ResolvePolicyPath on the in-VNet runner, joins each agent name to its live instance_identity.client_id (the appid/azp claim in the AgenticIdentityToken), DROPS any name with no matching live agent, and passes the resolved (AppId-enriched) policy to apim-mcp-compliance-all.bicep as the mcpPolicy parameter. 'azd provision' cannot resolve names (agents are not seeded yet) so it applies DENY-ALL (empty allowlist) -- a fresh environment is locked until the deploy-compliancy workflow grants access. DENY-BY-DEFAULT and PER-SERVER: on a given server, any agent not resolved+listed under that server (or a server with no entry here at all) is rejected with HTTP 403 -- an agent allowed on one server is NOT implicitly allowed on another.
